title: Wendell and the Orchard
author: B. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Ivo Vasquez, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
